applePromotionalText: Connect a compatible ring or device, review available wellness records, and sync saved data to your SayDian account on servers located in the United States.
appleDescription:
SayDian connects compatible devices, including supported smart rings and watches, to help you review everyday activity, sleep and available device-reported wellness readings.

ACTIVITY AND SLEEP
Review steps and sleep duration. Distance, estimated energy expenditure, sleep stages and workout details appear only when the connected device provides them. Missing or unsupported information is not presented as a measurement.

COMPATIBLE DEVICE READINGS
Supported devices such as U19S can provide blood pressure, heart rate and blood-oxygen readings. Availability depends on the connected device, its firmware and the app's supported connection channel. These features are not available with every ring or device. The phone does not measure these values by itself.

CONNECT AND SYNCHRONIZE
Connect over Bluetooth, check connection and battery status, and synchronize available records. Device controls vary by model. Keep the device nearby and the app in the foreground for manual synchronization.

YOUR RECORDS AND US CLOUD STORAGE
When signed in, saved activity, sleep, blood-pressure, heart-rate and blood-oxygen records can synchronize to your SayDian account on servers physically located in the United States. Pending uploads remain on your phone until the service acknowledges receipt. Record identifiers help avoid duplicate uploads. The app also keeps an encrypted local health-history cache. Optional services such as weather may process information separately as described in the privacy policy.

PROFILE AND FAMILY CARE
Manage your profile and account. Remote Care lets participating accounts choose permitted activity and sleep categories to share. Sharing requires permission and is not emergency monitoring. Health library provides general educational articles when published content is available in your language.

CHOICES AND SUPPORT
A compatible device is needed for device-generated readings. Sign-in, profile, help, legal documents and account deletion are available without a device. Optional camera, photos and location features ask for the relevant permissions. Manage permissions in iOS Settings and request account deletion under Profile > Account settings.

Wellness and device readings are for everyday reference. SayDian is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, emergency services, disease-risk assessment or medical decision support. Consult a doctor before making medical decisions; seek medical care if you feel unwell. The iOS edition does not provide ECG, AI health advice or paid health-analysis reports.

Support: https://app.saydian.com/global/support
Privacy: https://app.saydian.com/global/privacy-policy
Terms: https://app.saydian.com/global/terms
appleReviewNotes:
SayDian iOS 1.0.2, build 1023

This build replaces 1018. The former activity/sleep-only statement no longer describes the full current functionality.

Current scope
Compatible rings and devices provide activity and sleep. Supported Urion devices such as U19S additionally expose device-reported blood pressure, heart rate and blood oxygen when confirmed by device capabilities. Other connection channels do not automatically gain these measurement features. The same restrictions apply to every iOS user and build mode; there is no review-only or account-specific unlock. Unsupported readings stay unavailable. The phone does not measure these values independently. ECG, calibration, disease-risk assessments, medical alerts, AI health advice and paid health reports remain unavailable on iOS. Readings are for wellness reference, not diagnosis, treatment or emergency use. Consult a doctor before medical decisions.

Sign-in
Use the email/password already supplied in the protected App Review Information fields. The international service uses https://app.saydian.com/global/api/saydian-app/v2. No SMS/email verification code is required for password sign-in. Sign-in, profile, account settings, help, legal documents and account deletion do not require a device. Please use the protected credentials for this US service rather than a China-service account.

Connection and synchronization
Keep the compatible device powered, nearby and disconnected from other companion apps. Open Device > Search for devices, grant Bluetooth permission and select the actual device. Device controls depend on confirmed model capabilities. Keep the app in the foreground during manual sync. Saved activity/sleep and owned blood-pressure/heart-rate/oxygen records now synchronize to the US service, including the same international account's previously saved pending records. Only server acknowledgement completes an upload; failed/unconfirmed records remain pending. Repeated synchronization uses stable record identifiers. Separate Remote Care sharing on iOS remains permission-based and activity/sleep-only.

Privacy and account deletion
The reviewed published privacy policy and terms are version global-appstore-2026-11-04-r4 and explicitly disclose this iOS cloud-data scope. First-party account/device/synchronized data is stored on US servers. There is no automatic China-server fallback or import of another account's data. Weather handling and optional third-party processing are disclosed separately. Account deletion is available under Profile > Account settings. No health data is sent to an AI service by this iOS build.

Apple Health
The bundled BluetoothLibrary includes unused Apple Health references. The app does not enable HealthKit or request Apple Health access; required purpose strings state that the integration is inactive. Device synchronization uses the connected hardware directly.

Support: https://app.saydian.com/global/support
